"},{"id":551,"text":"local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local function initializeStandaloneTextLabel(label, minSize, maxSize)
    if not label then
        return
    end

    label.TextScaled = true
    label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 35, 21)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25

    local constraint = label:FindFirstChild("GameBackpackTextConstraint")
    if not constraint then
        constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
        constraint.Name = "GameBackpackTextConstraint"
        constraint.Parent = label
    end

    constraint.MinTextSize = minSize
    constraint.MaxTextSize = maxSize
end

initializeStandaloneTextLabel(InventoryCount, 12, 18)
initializeStandaloneTextLabel(OpenInfo, 11, 16)

local BASE_SLOT_SIZE = SlotTemplate.Size
local BASE_OPEN_BUTTON_SIZE = OpenButton.Size
local BASE_HOTBAR_PADDING = HotBarLayout and HotBarLayout.Padding or UDim.new(0, 0)

local hotbarButtons = {}
local inventoryButtons = {}
local preferredSlots = {}
local keySequence = {}
local nextKeySequence = 0
local inventoryOpen = false
local dirty = true
local currentCharacter = nil
local characterConnections = {}
local layoutState = {
    groups = {},
    slotToKey = {},
    inventoryKeys = {},
    equippedKey = nil,
}
local dragState = nil
local gamepadInventoryCursor = nil
local GAMEPAD_CURSOR_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 220)
local gamepadHotbarLock = nil
local GAMEPAD_LOCK_STROKE_COLOR   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
local GAMEPAD_CURSOR_STROKE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local placementConnections = {}
local lastPlacementSignature = ""
local coreHotbarVisibilityTags = {}
do
    local seenTags = {}
    for _, characterLo in ipairs(CharaterSetting.data) do
        if characterLo.hideEmptyCoreHotbarSlots then
            for _, fieldName in ipairs({"skill1Tag", "skill2Tag", "skill3Tag"}) do
                local tagName = characterLo[fieldName]
                if tagName and tagName ~= "" and not seenTags[tagName] then
                    seenTags[tagName] = true
                    table.insert(coreHotbarVisibilityTags, tagName)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function disconnectConnections(connections)
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(connections)
end

local function markDirty()
    dirty = true
end

local function bindCoreHotbarVisibilityTags()
    for _, tagName in ipairs(coreHotbarVisibilityTags) do
        CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tagName):Connect(function(instance)
            if instance == LocalPlayer then
                markDirty()
            end
        end)
        CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tagName):Connect(function(instance)
            if instance == LocalPlayer then
                markDirty()
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function toVector2(position)
    return Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)
end

local function normalizePointerPosition(point)
    point = point or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if not UIBagpack.IgnoreGuiInset then
        local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
        point -= inset
    end
    return point
end

local function isPointInGui(guiObject, point)
    if not guiObject or not guiObject.Visible then
        return false
    end

    local absolutePosition = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
    local absoluteSize = guiObject.AbsoluteSize
    return point.X >= absolutePosition.X
        and point.X <= absolutePosition.X + absoluteSize.X
        and point.Y >= absolutePosition.Y
        and point.Y <= absolutePosition.Y + absoluteSize.Y
end

local function canInteract()
    if not currentCharacter then
        return false
    end
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then
        return false
    end
    if currentCharacter:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function isMobileLayout()
    local narrowViewport = GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X <= 900
    return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and (not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled or narrowViewport)
end

local function getEffectiveHotbarSize()
    return isMobileLayout() and MOBILE_HOTBAR_SLOTS or HOTBAR_SIZE
end

local function getHotbarSafeGap()
    local screenWidth = math.max(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
    if isMobileLayout() then
        return math.clamp(math.floor(screenWidth * 0.03 + 0.5), 20, MOBILE_HOTBAR_SAFE_GAP)
    end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(screenWidth * 0.03 + 0.5), 24, DESKTOP_HOTBAR_SAFE_GAP)
end

local function getHotbarMinimumScale()
    if isMobileLayout() then
        return MOBILE_HOTBAR_MIN_SCALE
    end
    return DESKTOP_HOTBAR_MIN_SCALE
end

local function getBaseHotbarScale()
    if isMobileLayout() then
        return MOBILE_HOTBAR_BASE_SCALE
    end
    return 1
end

local function getResponsiveHotbarPosition()
    return BASE_HOTBAR_POSITION
end

local function getResponsiveHotbarSize()
    if isMobileLayout() then
        return MOBILE_HOTBAR_SIZE
    end
    return BASE_HOTBAR_SIZE
end

local function getResponsiveInventoryPosition()
    return BASE_INVENTORY_POSITION
end

local function getResponsiveInventorySize()
    return BASE_INVENTORY_SIZE
end

local function getKey(tool)
    if CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(tool) then
        local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("BluePrint_%d", lo.id)
    elseif ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
        local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("ResItem_%d", lo.id)
    end

    return tool.Name
end

local function getSlotLabel(index)
    return tostring(index)
end

local function getEquippedToolKey()
    local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if not equippedTool then
        return nil
    end
    return getKey(equippedTool)
end

local function getCoreSlotForTool(tool)
    if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bag) then
        return 1
    end
    if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then
        return 2
    end
    return nil
end

local function ensureKeySequence(key)
    if keySequence[key] then
        return
    end
    nextKeySequence += 1
    keySequence[key] = nextKeySequence
end

local function sortKeys(keys)
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
        return (keySequence[a] or 0) < (keySequence[b] or 0)
    end)
end

local function collectToolGroups()
    local groups = {}

    local function addTool(tool)
        if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
            return
        end

        local key = getKey(tool)
        if not key then
            return
        end

        ensureKeySequence(key)
        local group = groups[key]
        if not group then
            group = {
                key = key,
                tools = {},
                tool = tool,
            }
            groups[key] = group
        end

        table.insert(group.tools, tool)
    end

    if currentCharacter then
        for _, tool in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetChildren()) do
            addTool(tool)
        end
    end

    for _, tool in ipairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        addTool(tool)
    end

    return groups
end

local function buildLayoutState()
    local groups = collectToolGroups()
    for key in pairs(preferredSlots) do
        if not groups[key] then
            preferredSlots[key] = nil
        end
    end

    local slotToKey = {}
    local assignedKeys = {}
    local nonCoreKeys = {}

    for key, group in pairs(groups) do
        local coreSlot = getCoreSlotForTool(group.tool)
        if coreSlot then
            slotToKey[coreSlot] = key
            assignedKeys[key] = true
        else
            table.insert(nonCoreKeys, key)
        end
    end

    sortKeys(nonCoreKeys)

    for _, key in ipairs(nonCoreKeys) do
        local preferredSlot = preferredSlots[key]
        if type(preferredSlot) == "number"
            and preferredSlot >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT
            and preferredSlot <= getEffectiveHotbarSize()
            and not slotToKey[preferredSlot] then
            slotToKey[preferredSlot] = key
            assignedKeys[key] = true
        end
    end

    local pendingAutoKeys = {}
    local inventoryKeys = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(nonCoreKeys) do
        if not assignedKeys[key] then
            if preferredSlots[key] == "inventory" then
                table.insert(inventoryKeys, key)
            else
                table.insert(pendingAutoKeys, key)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, key in ipairs(pendingAutoKeys) do
        local assigned = false
        for slot = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            if not slotToKey[slot] then
                slotToKey[slot] = key
                assignedKeys[key] = true
                assigned = true
                break
            end
        end

        if not assigned then
            table.insert(inventoryKeys, key)
        end
    end

    for slot = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
        local key = slotToKey[slot]
        if key and preferredSlots[key] == nil then
            preferredSlots[key] = slot
        end
    end

    sortKeys(inventoryKeys)

    return {
        groups = groups,
        slotToKey = slotToKey,
        inventoryKeys = inventoryKeys,
        equippedKey = getEquippedToolKey(),
    }
end

local function destroyInventoryButtons()
    for _, button in ipairs(inventoryButtons) do
        button:Destroy()
    end
    table.clear(inventoryButtons)
end

local function setButtonPalette(button, isEquipped, isCore, isEmpty)
    local top = button:FindFirstChild("Top")
    local backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(118, 101, 69)
    local topColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local bgTransparency = 0.5

    if isEmpty then
        backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(82, 74, 62)
        topColor = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
        bgTransparency = 0.5
    end
    if isCore then
        backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    end
    if isEquipped then
        backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(189, 150, 70)
        topColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 191)
    end

    button.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
    button.BackgroundTransparency = bgTransparency
    if top then
        top.ImageColor3 = topColor
    end
end

local function applyResponsiveLayout()
    HotBar.Size = getResponsiveHotbarSize()
    Inventory.Size = getResponsiveInventorySize()

    if isMobileLayout() then
        ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 12
    else
        ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 8
    end

    if OpenInfo2 then
        OpenInfo2.Visible = not isMobileLayout()
    end
end

local function tuneTextLabel(label, minSize, maxSize, allowWrap)
    if not label then
        return
    end

    label.TextScaled = true
    label.TextWrapped = allowWrap
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 35, 21)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = isMobileLayout() and 0.2 or 0.35

    local constraint = label:FindFirstChild("GameBackpackTextConstraint")
    if not constraint then
        constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
        constraint.Name = "GameBackpackTextConstraint"
        constraint.Parent = label
    end

    if isMobileLayout() then
        constraint.MinTextSize = minSize
        constraint.MaxTextSize = maxSize
    else
        constraint.MinTextSize = math.max(10, minSize - 1)
        constraint.MaxTextSize = math.max(constraint.MinTextSize, maxSize - 2)
    end
end

local function applyButtonTextStyle(button)
    tuneTextLabel(button:FindFirstChild("t_name"), 12, 20, true)
    tuneTextLabel(button:FindFirstChild("t_value"), 11, 18, false)
end

local function updateInventoryGridLayout()
    if not InventoryGridLayout then
        return
    end

    local cellWidth = 96
    local cellHeight = 96
    local sampleButton = hotbarButtons[1]
    if sampleButton and sampleButton.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and sampleButton.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
        cellWidth = math.floor(sampleButton.AbsoluteSize.X + 0.5)
        cellHeight = math.floor(sampleButton.AbsoluteSize.Y + 0.5)
    end

    local padding = math.max(isMobileLayout() and 12 or 10, math.floor(cellWidth * 0.12))
    if HotBarLayout then
        padding = math.max(padding, math.floor(cellWidth * HotBarLayout.Padding.Scale * 1.2 + 0.5))
    end

    local availableWidth = math.max(ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.X, cellWidth)
    local maxCells = math.max(2, math.floor((availableWidth + padding) / (cellWidth + padding)))
    if isMobileLayout() then
        maxCells = math.min(maxCells, 6)
    end

    InventoryGridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(cellWidth, cellHeight)
    InventoryGridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(padding, padding)
    InventoryGridLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells = maxCells
end

local function getInterfaceRoot()
    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    return playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("UIInterface")
end

local function getRightBlockerRoot()
    local interface = getInterfaceRoot()
    if not interface then
        return nil
    end

    local desktopInteractive = interface:FindFirstChild("UIInteractive")
    local mobileInteractive = interface:FindFirstChild("UIInteractiveMobile")

    if isMobileLayout() then
        if mobileInteractive and mobileInteractive.Visible then
            return mobileInteractive
        end
        if desktopInteractive and desktopInteractive.Visible then
            return desktopInteractive
        end
        return nil
    end

    if desktopInteractive and desktopInteractive.Visible then
        return desktopInteractive
    end
    if mobileInteractive and mobileInteractive.Visible then
        return mobileInteractive
    end

    return nil
end

local function getLeftBlockerRoot()
    if isMobileLayout() then
        return nil
    end

    local interface = getInterfaceRoot()
    if not interface then
        return nil
    end

    local gunBulletFrame = interface:FindFirstChild("UIGunBulletFrame")
    if gunBulletFrame and gunBulletFrame.Visible and gunBulletFrame.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and gunBulletFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
        return gunBulletFrame
    end

    return nil
end

local function scaleOffset(value, scale)
    if value == 0 then
        return 0
    end
    return math.floor(value * scale + 0.5)
end

local function applyHotbarScale(scale)
    for _, button in ipairs(hotbarButtons) do
        if button then
            button.Size = UDim2.new(
                BASE_SLOT_SIZE.X.Scale * scale,
                scaleOffset(BASE_SLOT_SIZE.X.Offset, scale),
                BASE_SLOT_SIZE.Y.Scale * scale,
                scaleOffset(BASE_SLOT_SIZE.Y.Offset, scale)
            )
        end
    end

    OpenButton.Size = UDim2.new(
        BASE_OPEN_BUTTON_SIZE.X.Scale * scale,
        scaleOffset(BASE_OPEN_BUTTON_SIZE.X.Offset, scale),
        BASE_OPEN_BUTTON_SIZE.Y.Scale * scale,
        scaleOffset(BASE_OPEN_BUTTON_SIZE.Y.Offset, scale)
    )

    if HotBarLayout then
        HotBarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(
            BASE_HOTBAR_PADDING.Scale * scale,
            scaleOffset(BASE_HOTBAR_PADDING.Offset, scale)
        )
    end
end

local function expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, guiObject)
    if not guiObject or not guiObject.Visible then
        return leftEdge, rightEdge
    end
    if guiObject.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 or guiObject.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 then
        return leftEdge, rightEdge
    end

    local candidateLeft = guiObject.AbsolutePosition.X
    local candidateRight = candidateLeft + guiObject.AbsoluteSize.X
    if leftEdge == nil or candidateLeft < leftEdge then
        leftEdge = candidateLeft
    end
    if rightEdge == nil or candidateRight > rightEdge then
        rightEdge = candidateRight
    end
    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function getGuiHorizontalBounds(rootGui)
    if not rootGui then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local leftEdge, rightEdge = nil, nil
    for _, descendant in ipairs(rootGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
            leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, descendant)
        end
    end

    if leftEdge == nil or rightEdge == nil then
        leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, rootGui)
    end

    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
    local leftEdge, rightEdge = nil, nil

    for _, child in ipairs(HotBar:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, child)
        end
    end

    if Inventory.Visible then
        leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, Inventory)
    end

    if leftEdge == nil or rightEdge == nil then
        leftEdge = HotBar.AbsolutePosition.X
        rightEdge = leftEdge + HotBar.AbsoluteSize.X
    end

    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function applyBackpackPlacement(horizontalOffset)
    local hotbarPosition = getResponsiveHotbarPosition()
    local inventoryPosition = getResponsiveInventoryPosition()

    HotBar.Position = UDim2.new(
        hotbarPosition.X.Scale,
        hotbarPosition.X.Offset + horizontalOffset,
        hotbarPosition.Y.Scale,
        hotbarPosition.Y.Offset
    )
    Inventory.Position = UDim2.new(
        inventoryPosition.X.Scale,
        inventoryPosition.X.Offset + horizontalOffset,
        inventoryPosition.Y.Scale,
        inventoryPosition.Y.Offset
    )
end

local function updateBackpackPlacement()
    applyResponsiveLayout()
    applyHotbarScale(getBaseHotbarScale())
    applyBackpackPlacement(0)
    task.defer(function()
        local safeGap = getHotbarSafeGap()
        local screenWidth = math.max(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local screenPadding = isMobileLayout() and MOBILE_SCREEN_PADDING or 0
        local leftBlocker = getLeftBlockerRoot()
        local rightBlocker = getRightBlockerRoot()
        local minimumLeftEdge = screenPadding
        if leftBlocker then
            local _, blockerRight = getGuiHorizontalBounds(leftBlocker)
            minimumLeftEdge = (blockerRight or (leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + leftBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + safeGap
        end

        local maximumRightEdge = screenWidth - screenPadding
        if rightBlocker then
            local blockerLeft = getGuiHorizontalBounds(rightBlocker)
            maximumRightEdge = (blockerLeft or rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) - safeGap
        end

        local leftEdge, rightEdge = getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
        local width = math.max(0, rightEdge - leftEdge)
        local availableWidth = maximumRightEdge - minimumLeftEdge
        if availableWidth > 0 and width > availableWidth then
            local targetScale = getBaseHotbarScale() * (availableWidth / width)
            applyHotbarScale(math.max(getHotbarMinimumScale(), math.min(getBaseHotbarScale(), targetScale)))
        end

        task.defer(function()
            local finalLeftEdge, finalRightEdge = getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
            local finalWidth = math.max(0, finalRightEdge - finalLeftEdge)
            local currentCenter = finalLeftEdge + finalWidth / 2
            local minimumCenter = minimumLeftEdge + finalWidth / 2
            local maximumCenter = maximumRightEdge - finalWidth / 2
            local targetCenter = currentCenter

            if minimumCenter <= maximumCenter then
                targetCenter = math.clamp(currentCenter, minimumCenter, maximumCenter)
            else
                targetCenter = (minimumCenter + maximumCenter) / 2
            end

            local horizontalOffset = targetCenter - currentCenter
            if horizontalOffset >= 0 then
                horizontalOffset = math.floor(horizontalOffset + 0.5)
            else
                horizontalOffset = math.ceil(horizontalOffset - 0.5)
            end

            applyBackpackPlacement(horizontalOffset)
            updateInventoryGridLayout()
        end)
    end)
end

local function bindPlacementWatchers()
    local interface = getInterfaceRoot()
    if not interface then
        return
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(placementConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(placementConnections)

    for _, guiName in ipairs({"UIInteractive", "UIInteractiveMobile", "UIGunBulletFrame"}) do
        local guiObject = interface:FindFirstChild(guiName)
        if guiObject then
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
        end
    end
end

local function getPlacementSignature()
    local leftBlocker = getLeftBlockerRoot()
    local rightBlocker = getRightBlockerRoot()
    local leftSignature = "none"
    if leftBlocker then
        local leftBound, rightBound = getGuiHorizontalBounds(leftBlocker)
        leftSignature = string.format(
            "%d:%d",
            math.floor((leftBound or leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) + 0.5),
            math.floor((rightBound or (leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + leftBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + 0.5)
        )
    end

    local rightSignature = "none"
    if rightBlocker then
        local leftBound, rightBound = getGuiHorizontalBounds(rightBlocker)
        rightSignature = string.format(
            "%d:%d",
            math.floor((leftBound or rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) + 0.5),
            math.floor((rightBound or (rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + rightBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + 0.5)
        )
    end

    return table.concat({
        isMobileLayout() and "mobile" or "desktop",
        tostring(math.floor(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X + 0.5)),
        tostring(math.floor(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.Y + 0.5)),
        inventoryOpen and "open" or "closed",
        leftSignature,
        rightSignature,
    }, "|")
end

local function shouldHideEmptyCoreHotbarSlots()

    return false

local function shouldShowHotbarSlot(slotIndex, key)
    if slotIndex > getEffectiveHotbarSize() then
        return false
    end

    if slotIndex <= 2 then
        return key ~= nil or not shouldHideEmptyCoreHotbarSlots()
    end

    if inventoryOpen then
        return true
    end

    return key ~= nil
end

local function configureHotbarButton(button, slotIndex, key)
    applyButtonTextStyle(button)
    local nameLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local valueLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_value")
    local group = key and layoutState.groups[key] or nil
    local amount = group and #group.tools or 0
    local isCore = slotIndex <= 2
    local slotLabel = getSlotLabel(slotIndex)
    local equipped = key ~= nil and key == layoutState.equippedKey
    local isVisible = shouldShowHotbarSlot(slotIndex, key)

    button.LayoutOrder = slotIndex
    button.Visible = isVisible
    button.Active = isVisible
    button.Name = string.format("HotbarSlot_%d", slotIndex)
    button:SetAttribute("SlotIndex", slotIndex)
    button:SetAttribute("ToolKey", key or "")

    if nameLabel then
        if group then
            nameLabel.Text = group.tool.Name
        elseif isCore then
            nameLabel.Text = CORE_SLOT_LABELS[slotIndex]
        else
            nameLabel.Text = ""
        end
        if isMobileLayout() then
            nameLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        else
            nameLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.512602866, 0, 0.0222559497, 0)
        end
    end

    if valueLabel then
        if isMobileLayout() then
            valueLabel.Visible = false
        else
            valueLabel.Visible = true
            if amount > 1 then
                valueLabel.Text = string.format("%s x%d", slotLabel, amount)
            else
                valueLabel.Text = slotLabel
            end
        end
    end

    setButtonPalette(button, equipped, isCore, key == nil)
end

local function configureInventoryButton(button, key)
    applyButtonTextStyle(button)
    local nameLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local valueLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_value")
    local group = layoutState.groups[key]
    local equipped = key == layoutState.equippedKey

    button.Name = "InventoryItem_" .. key
    button.Size = SlotTemplate.Size
    button.AnchorPoint = SlotTemplate.AnchorPoint
    button.Position = SlotTemplate.Position
    button.LayoutOrder = keySequence[key] or 0
    button.Visible = true
    button:SetAttribute("ToolKey", key)

    if nameLabel then

            valueLabel.Text = string.format("x%d", #group.tools)

local function resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not source then
        return nil
    end
    if source.kind == "inventory" then
        return source.key
    end
    if source.kind == "hotbar" then
        return layoutState.slotToKey[source.slotIndex]
    end
    return nil
end

local function triggerSlot(key)
    if not key or not canInteract() then
        return
    end

    local group = layoutState.groups[key]
    if not group or not group.tools[1] then
        return
    end

    if key == layoutState.equippedKey then
        ToolHelper.UnequipToolsC2S:FireServer()
    else
        ToolHelper.EquipToolC2S:FireServer(group.tools[1])
    end
    markDirty()
end

local function canDragSource(source)
    local key = resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not key then
        return false
    end
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex <= 2 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getDropTarget(point)
    local pt = Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y)

    if isMobileLayout() then
        local bestSlot, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            local btn = hotbarButtons[slotIndex]
            if btn and btn.Visible then
                local center = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
                local dist = (pt - center).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestSlot = slotIndex
                end
            end
        end
        local refBtn = hotbarButtons[FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT]
        local snapRadius = refBtn and refBtn.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.5 or 80
        if bestSlot and bestDist <= snapRadius then
            return { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = bestSlot }
        end
    else
        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            if isPointInGui(hotbarButtons[slotIndex], point) then
                return { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = slotIndex }
            end
        end
    end

    if inventoryOpen and (isPointInGui(ScrollingFrame, point) or isPointInGui(InventoryFrame, point)) then
        return { kind = "inventory" }
    end

    return nil
end

local function applyDrop(source, target)
    if not source or not target then
        return
    end

    local sourceKey = resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not sourceKey then
        return
    end

    if target.kind == "inventory" then
        if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
            preferredSlots[sourceKey] = "inventory"
            markDirty()
        end
        return
    end

    if target.kind ~= "hotbar" or target.slotIndex < FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
        return
    end

    local targetKey = layoutState.slotToKey[target.slotIndex]
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex == target.slotIndex then
        return
    end

    preferredSlots[sourceKey] = target.slotIndex
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
        if targetKey and targetKey ~= sourceKey then
            preferredSlots[targetKey] = source.slotIndex
        end
    elseif targetKey and targetKey ~= sourceKey then
        preferredSlots[targetKey] = "inventory"
    end

    markDirty()
end

local function stopDragging()
    if dragState and dragState.ghost then
        dragState.ghost:Destroy()
    end
    dragState = nil
end

local function finishHold()
    if not dragState then
        return
    end

    local activeDrag = dragState
    local pointer = activeDrag.pointerPosition or normalizePointerPosition()
    stopDragging()

    if activeDrag.dragging and canDragSource(activeDrag.source) then
        local target = getDropTarget(pointer)
        applyDrop(activeDrag.source, target)
        return
    end

    triggerSlot(resolveSourceKey(activeDrag.source))
end

local function cycleHotbar(direction)
    local occupiedSlots = {}
    for slotIndex = 1, HOTBAR_SIZE do
        if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
            table.insert(occupiedSlots, slotIndex)
        end
    end
    if #occupiedSlots == 0 then
        return
    end
    local currentPos = nil
    for i, slotIndex in ipairs(occupiedSlots) do
        if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
            currentPos = i
            break
        end
    end
    local nextPos
    if currentPos then
        nextPos = (currentPos - 1 + direction) % #occupiedSlots + 1
    else
        nextPos = direction == 1 and 1 or #occupiedSlots
    end
    triggerSlot(layoutState.slotToKey[occupiedSlots[nextPos]])
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if inventoryOpen then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB
            or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
            toggleInventory(false)
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                local key = layoutState.inventoryKeys[gamepadInventoryCursor]
                if key then
                    local targetSlot = nil
                    for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                        if not layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
                            targetSlot = slotIndex
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not targetSlot then
                        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                            if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
                                targetSlot = slotIndex
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if targetSlot then
                        applyDrop({ kind = "inventory", key = key }, { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = targetSlot })
                        triggerSlot(key)
                        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                            Title = "Equipped", Text = "Item added to hotbar", Duration = 2
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                local key = layoutState.inventoryKeys[gamepadInventoryCursor]
                if key then
                    local targetSlot = gamepadHotbarLock
                    if not targetSlot then
                        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                            if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
                                targetSlot = slotIndex
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if targetSlot then
                        applyDrop({ kind = "inventory", key = key }, { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = targetSlot })
                    end
                    toggleInventory(false)
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                gamepadInventoryCursor = gamepadInventoryCursor % #layoutState.inventoryKeys + 1
                markDirty()
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                gamepadInventoryCursor = (gamepadInventoryCursor - 2) % #layoutState.inventoryKeys + 1
                markDirty()
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
            local direction = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight and 1 or -1
            local occupiedSlots = {}
            for slotIndex = 1, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
                    table.insert(occupiedSlots, slotIndex)
                end
            end
            if #occupiedSlots > 0 then
                local currentPos = nil
                for i, slotIndex in ipairs(occupiedSlots) do
                    if slotIndex == gamepadHotbarLock
                        or (not gamepadHotbarLock and layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey) then
                        currentPos = i; break
                    end
                end
                local nextPos = currentPos
                    and (currentPos - 1 + direction) % #occupiedSlots + 1
                    or (direction == 1 and 1 or #occupiedSlots)
                local nextSlot = occupiedSlots[nextPos]
                removeLockStroke(gamepadHotbarLock)
                gamepadHotbarLock = nextSlot

local function AnimateGif(ImageLabel:ImageLabel,ImageWidth,ImageHeight,Rows,Columns,NumberOfFrames,ImageId,FPS)
	
	--if ImageId then ImageLabel.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. ImageId end
	
	local RealWidth, RealHeight

	if math.max(ImageWidth,ImageHeight) > RobloxMaxImageSize then -- Compensate roblox size

		local Longest = ImageWidth > ImageHeight and "Width" or "Height"

		if Longest == "Width" then

			RealWidth = RobloxMaxImageSize
			RealHeight = (RealWidth / ImageWidth) * ImageHeight

		elseif Longest == "Height" then

			RealHeight = RobloxMaxImageSize
			RealWidth = (RealHeight / ImageHeight) * ImageWidth

		end

	else
		RealWidth,RealHeight = ImageWidth,ImageHeight
	end

	local FrameSize = Vector2.new(RealWidth/Columns,RealHeight/Rows)
	ImageLabel.ImageRectSize = FrameSize

	local CurrentRow, CurrentColumn = 0,0
	local Offsets = {}

	for i = 1,NumberOfFrames do

		local CurrentX = CurrentColumn * FrameSize.X
		local CurrentY = CurrentRow * FrameSize.Y

		table.insert(Offsets,Vector2.new(CurrentX,CurrentY))

		CurrentColumn += 1

		if CurrentColumn >= Columns then
			CurrentColumn = 0
			CurrentRow += 1
		end

	end
	
	local TimeInterval = FPS and 1/FPS or 0.1
	
	local Index = 0
	task.spawn(function()

		while task.wait(TimeInterval) and ImageLabel:IsDescendantOf(game) do
			Index += 1

			ImageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Offsets[Index]

			if Index >= NumberOfFrames then
				Index = 0
			end

		end

	end)

end
